why: The v1.2.11 pin move changed four classes. None of them can reach a shipped graph in a way the 2026-09-05 smoke did not already cover, and the two that could were executed for real on 2026-09-07 against the current graphs. This attestation records that reasoning per class so the gate does not have to guess, and it expires the moment either pin moves.

MpiClearVram.reason: Behaviour is unchanged. The node's body was lifted verbatim into a module-level _clear_vram() helper which it now calls: same four operations (gc.collect, unload_all_models, soft_empty_cache, and the cuda empty_cache/ipc_collect pair), same order, same guard. Flagged only because vram.py's module shell changed when MpiClearVramEnd was added alongside it. Reviewed against `git diff 8505769..287edb8 -- vram.py`.

MpiSaveVideo.reason: RETURN_TYPES went from () to ("STRING",) with RETURN_NAMES ("video_path",); the ui payload is byte-identical so the preview is unaffected. The new socket is connected NOWHERE: 15 runtime graphs contain MpiSaveVideo and 0 nodes consume any of its outputs, so no shipped graph's execution can differ. It was also exercised end-to-end on 2026-09-07 — every one of the 18 generations below was written to disk by this node and decoded to a thumbnail.

evidence.artefacts: 18 playable mp4s, each with a decoded .thumb.jpg, recorded in Media/.meta sidecars

MpiWindowedSampler.reason: New in v1.2.11 and baked into both H3 runtimes by f91438ca (2026-09-06 18:31), which is what made the 2026-09-05 H3 smoke rows genuinely stale. It appears in no other runtime graph. Fabio ran all three H3 ops against the post-bake graphs on 2026-09-07 — partly for the express purpose of checking this node — and watched the output. comfy_workflows/ and node_lock.json have both been untouched since 15:37Z that day, so what ran is what ships.

deliberately_not_attested.MpiClearVramEnd: New node, and no runtime graph loads it — it exists only in comfy_workflows/raw/ and scripts/workflow_generation/ templates, which are authoring inputs and are never dispatched. It needs no attestation: the gate finds zero graphs for it on its own. Left here as the worked example of the narrowing doing its job.

ComfyUI-MelodramaBox.reason: No shipped graph loads this pack. Every class it registers is named DramaBox* (17, NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS in __init__.py at 529c4be) and none appears anywhere under comfy_workflows/, raw/ and scripts/ included: DramaBox ships as a paid package Flow since MPI-781, so its graph is not in this repo and the 2026-09-28 smoke never ran it. The hop itself is one fix (dramabox_nodes/model/patcher.py: always fully load, MPI-1008) plus NOTICE. Fabio 2026-10-01: no re-smoke for this move.

ComfyUI-Mickmumpitz-Nodes.reason: REMOVED from the lock at the 2.0 cut (Fabio 2026-10-02). No shipped graph loads this pack: its 84 classes (every NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS key across the pack's .py files at 4d5ff7c, read with ast) appear in none of the 109 JSON graphs under comfy_workflows/, scripts/, and the paid Flow packages in c:/AI/Mpi/Cubric-Flows (Head Swap, DramaBox). The last users were Outpaint's HarmonizeBoundary + ComposeColorMatch, removed by MPI-1011 (bf9588d59); Outpaint itself is re-smoked at the cut because its graph changed. Its requirements stay in python_deps.in for other packs, so python_deps.txt is byte-identical.
